summary: Euroholdings Ltd., via a Form 6-K, reported Q1 2026 results and disclosed the acquisition of a 49,997 DWT MR product tanker vessel, M/T Hellas Fighter (built 2015), from a related party of majority shareholder Marla Investments Inc. (not under common control) for $39.25 million. Delivery is expected between mid-June and mid-August 2026. The transaction was approved by an independent committee of disinterested directors. Financing will use own funds and debt. This acquisition expands the fleet and continues the company's shift into product tankers, with the vessel expected to contribute to profitability. Risk-arb angle: watch for financing details and regulatory approvals for the related-party purchase.
